facts: The August 10 company release labels the infrastructure summary as of July 31, 2026.
The Fox Creek row identifies the June 2026 groundbreaking as power-plant work and states the data-center design is underway.
The older June 2 integrated-facility announcement therefore does not unambiguously establish physical data-center construction at the cutoff.
guardrails: Do not transfer power-plant construction to a data-center lifecycle observation.
Do not promote a generation-plant location to the data-center building or campus footprint.
This review does not claim that no data-center work ever occurred; it withholds acceptance until that work is evidenced.
decisions.next_required_evidence: Dated authoritative physical work on the data-center component within the fixed freshness window, plus exact project-bound geometry.

facts: The bounded OSM query returned five Ascenty-tagged ways but none named Sumare or carrying a matching street address.
Way 713804589 and building 1420053797 are approximately 9 km south of the unaccepted owner-map camera center; other returned objects are substations.
No result is admitted as the Sumare campus merely because the operator name matches.
guardrails: The owner iframe's camera-center numbers remain unaccepted; this independent OSM query does not validate them.
Substations, unrelated named campuses, and arbitrary building centroids are not substitutes for Sumare 3 geometry.
decisions.next_required_evidence: Operator-published site coordinates or an independently named/address-bound official or community site feature.

facts: OSM node 13509301320 is named Scala Datacenter but has operator=Equinix and no street-address tag.
The certificate separately lists SGRUTB01 at Avenida Ceci 1900, SGRUTB04 at Rua Joao Ferreira de Camargo 1217, and SGRUTB12 at Avenida Ceci 1649, Bloco 03.
The certificate does not name SGRUTB07, SGRUTB09, SGRUTB10, or SGRUTB11.
guardrails: The conflicting OSM node is not selected.
Known constituent addresses could support a carefully bound campus locator but are not exact new-building addresses.
SGRUTB07, SGRUTB09, SGRUTB10, and SGRUTB11 are at most one new physical campus, not four new sites.
The old start-up forecasts on the live portfolio do not establish completion; an independent successor check is still required before admission.
decisions.next_required_evidence: Source-specific location tied to the Tambore campus or selected facility, with OSM operator conflict resolved or an independent authoritative locator.

facts: The certificate lists SMEXTP01 at Calle 6 de Enero, Las Animas, CP 54616, Tepotzotlan.
It does not list SMEXTP02 or demonstrate that the two codes share one physical campus.
guardrails: Do not transfer SMEXTP01's certificate address or operating status to SMEXTP02 by locality alone.
decisions.next_required_evidence: An exact SMEXTP02 address or documented campus relationship, then independently resolved geometry.
